---
title: "README"
output: pdf_document
---

00_requirements.R: installs missing R packages and loads packages used in the project.
Data/Most-Recent-Cohorts-Institution.csv: original College Scorecard source data.
11_DataCleaning.RMD: imports the original CSV, selects the requested Pell variables, institution identifiers, ICLEVEL, PREDDEG, C150_4, and all PCIP variables; checks missingness and duplicate IDs; saves the cleaned data.
01_funct_DataCleaning.R: functions from DataCleaning.RMD
12_DataSaving.csv: cleaned data, saved to csv file
21_Dataprocessing.RMD: loads the cleaned data, selects four-year institutions, calculates the selected STEM degree share, classifies institutions, aggregates measures by state, and saves processed data.
02_funct_DataProcessing.R: functions from Dataprocessing.RMD
31_DataVisualization.RMD: loads processed data and creates exploratory plots and descriptive statistics.
03_funct_DataVisualization.R: functions from DataVisualization.RMD
12/22_DataSaving.RData: saved work environments, to be loaded for analysis
31-36: plots and summary tables generated by the visualization workflow.
FinalReport.Rmd: report
